title: The WSG+MOP normalization tail batch (census 947)

banner.title: The WSG+MOP normalization tail batch - the 23 defs (15 WSG, 8 MOP) rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission
banner.provenance: The normalization tail - the per-book schema pass enters its tail (the R879 normalizer doctrine, the R1009-R1014 MM1 arc, R1016 the OA book close, R1017-R1020 the MM2 arc closed, R1021-R1023 the FF arc closed): the 15 WSG service animals and the 8 MOP outsider defs rewritten to the canonical FIELD_ORDER emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; the 15 real WSG service role masks ride untouched - only absent keys read the sentinels; all 199 patches are anchored sentinel inserts under the single-line anchor doctrine (the R1021 aarakocra lesson); no reorders, no comma sites, no pin repairs - neither book carries fragment grids; the loader reads the sentinels under the R879 uniform coercer doctrine already live on the 972 normalized MM1, MM2, OA and FF defs

audit_comment: THE NORMALIZATION TAIL BATCH - the 23 defs (15 WSG service animals, 8 MOP outsiders) rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; the 15 real WSG service role masks preserved byte-identical; every patch an anchored sentinel insert.
include_after: #include "rules/ff/normalization_batch3.h"  // R1023: the FF normalization batch three

consts.name: wt1Round
consts.comment: the WSG+MOP normalization tail batch - the 23 defs, the per-book pass enters its tail

consts.name: wt1DefsNormalized
consts.comment: the defs rewritten to full-field canonical form this batch - 15 WSG, 8 MOP

consts.name: wt1WsgDefs
consts.comment: the WSG defs in the batch (the service animals - bears, camels, dogs, donkeys, elephants, horses, rams, sheep, yak)

consts.name: wt1MopDefs
consts.comment: the MOP defs in the batch (the five archons, the einheriar, the marut, the mortai)

consts.name: wt1TailNormalizedAfter
consts.comment: the WSG and MOP defs carrying the full-field emission after this batch - the tail complete

consts.name: wt1TailRemaining
consts.comment: the WSG and MOP defs still sparse after this batch - NONE, the tail closed

consts.name: wt1SchemaKeys
consts.comment: the canonical FIELD_ORDER length - every def emitted with all 57 keys

consts.name: wt1InsSites
consts.comment: the anchored insert sites - 568 inserted lines, all sentinel fields

consts.name: wt1CommaSites
consts.comment: the trailing-comma whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, every text field already carried the Lua-optional comma

consts.name: wt1ReorderDefs
consts.comment: the defs needing whole-line rewrites - NONE this batch, the fields already in canonical FIELD_ORDER

consts.name: wt1WsgRolesMasks
consts.comment: the WSG defs carrying REAL service role masks (1/3/5/7) - the values ride untouched, only the absent keys read the sentinels

consts.name: wt1PatchEntries
consts.comment: the file patches this round - 199 monster windows, all anchored sentinel inserts

bools.name: wt1NormalizerCensusLive
bools.comment: the landed normalize_registry.py reads its full 1338-def census - the registry floor live

bools.name: wt1FullFieldEmission
bools.comment: every rewritten def carries all 57 keys - string sentinel n/a, integer sentinel -1, saveAsBonus the loader zero default

bools.name: wt1InsertOnly
bools.comment: zero whole-line rewrites, zero deletes - every patch an anchored insert, the single-line anchor doctrine (the R1021 aarakocra lesson held, the second engine pass simulated in full pre-handoff)

bools.name: wt1WsgRolesPreserved
bools.comment: the 15 real WSG service role masks byte-identical through the batch - the sweep pins the value invariance per def

bools.name: wt1NoClassedDefs
bools.comment: no classed defs in the batch - zero saveAs keys, the R155 contract untouched
